executionTimeout.description:
Timeout for execution of each cell.

Can be overridden individually by specifying {@link JupyterNotebook.Cell.ExecSpec#executionTimeout} for cell.
If the cell has not finished executing when the timeout expires, the kernel will be interrupted and InterruptedException will be recorded as the cell execution result.

gracefulInterruptTimeout.description: How many seconds to wait after a session is {@link JupyterLab.Session#interrupt interrupted} due to {@link #executionTimeout timeout} before raising an exception. This additional time is used collect cell outputs.

title: Spec for running Jupyter notebook {@link JupyterNotebook.Cell cells} via the {@link JupyterLab.Session#run} method.
